stem:
The diagram shows Gita holding a cardboard cut-out between a torch and a white wall. Light from the torch is blocked by the cut-out before it reaches the wall.

Which change makes the shadow on the wall smaller?

options.text: Moving the cut-out closer to the wall.
Moving the cut-out closer to the torch.
Using a brighter torch in the same places.

teacher.key_rationale: Moving the opaque cut-out closer to the wall shrinks the shadow. Moving it closer to the torch enlarges the shadow. Switching the torch off removes the shadow; brightness alone in the same places does not shrink it.
teacher.figure_note: Torch, cardboard cut-out, and shadow on a wall.
